WHAT WE DO

Built around the outcome.

Every engagement begins with what you need to accomplish. From one focused project to a fully integrated program, strategy, creative, distribution, and execution all live under one roof.

Articles + press

Branded articles, thought leadership, contributed content, press release support, and executive storytelling with trusted industry context. Content is structured to be useful to readers and easier for search and AI systems to understand.

Full-service webinars

Strategy, landing page, registration, promotion, live production, reporting, and on-demand distribution, managed by one experienced team.

Integrated programs

Custom combinations of content, press, discovery, webinar, video, lead generation, and media, built around a clear commercial objective.

AI Discoverability

Video + custom projects

Interviews, brand stories, explainers, research, surveys, buyer guides, and pre-roll and post-roll advertising across relevant video programming.

Visibility + lead generation

Premium display, newsletter sponsorship, and native lead generation build reach, frequency, targeted traffic, and qualified interest.

Everything your creative team needs for a clean, accurate handoff.

Roadblock: contact Brandi for placement details. Dimensions and weights above follow the mg digital technical specifications updated August 8, 2025; confirm any custom placement before production.

File requirements

Ready for production

Static display

JPG, PNG, or GIF. Files must match the dimensions and maximum weights above.

Animated GIF

GIF only. Each loop: no more than 15 seconds; maximum three loops before stopping; at least 15 fps.

Video ads

MP4 with H.264 video and AAC encoding. Duration: 15–30 seconds. Initial load no more than 150 KB; total file no more than 5 MB. No audio.

Custom placements

For pre-roll and post-roll advertising, alternate creative sizes, or program-specific production needs, check the final placement details with Brandi before building artwork.

Contributed content guidelines

Helping industry experts become trusted sources.

The strongest contributed articles teach readers something useful and show how an expert thinks. They should help cannabis industry professionals make better decisions.

The approach

Share expertise, not a sales message.

Strong topics

  • Industry trends and insights
  • Best practices and lessons learned
  • Operational expertise
  • Leadership perspectives
  • Regulatory and compliance observations
  • Data, research, and analysis

What to avoid

  • Product pitches and sales language
  • Press release-style content
  • Overly promotional company messaging
  • Previously published articles
Submission

What to send

Article

Typically 750–1,500 words. Original and exclusive before publication.

Author

A short biography and high-resolution headshot.

Additional visuals

High-resolution images are encouraged; MP4 video is accepted.

Editing

mg may edit for style, grammar, and formatting.

Why it matters

Build a useful body of knowledge.

An insightful article gives professionals a reason to trust your expertise. Clear, original answers also provide context that search and AI-powered tools can use to understand the topics you know best.
